Vlaamse Interuniversitaire Raad voor Universitaire Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (VLIR-UOS)

description.narrative: There is a longstanding history of cooperation between Peru and Belgian higher education institutions. Peru continues to be an important partner country in the VLIR-UOS portfolio with a mid-range budget. VLIR-UOS supports interventions that strengthen higher education, research and extension in various domains. All interventions frame within the VLIR-UOS Country Strategy for Peru which is aligned with national development and higher education priorities. The strategy is translated in to the following main themes: Environment (incl. mining impact, climate change, natural resources, biodiversity), Food security and agriculture (farming systems, rural development, value chains, ..), Health (nutrition, virology, public health/mental health and care), Economy (SME & private sector development, financial inclusion, …), Government & society (good governance/civil society, social development, conflict prevention, indigenous communities, multi-ethnicity). Transversal support themes are: Institutional strengthening linked to university management, quality of research and education (incl. statistics) and academic English. In the 2017-2021 period, the long term institutional cooperation programme with Universiddad Nacional Agraria La Molina (UNALM) continues its second phase of consolidation and finalisation of PhD trainings before entering a finalisation stage (Phase Out). Also one South Initiative started in 2017. A number of new projects for Peru will still be selected in the 2017-2021 period.
